gen-gf-baumans-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Wrench-mouthed, uniform lettering: Baumans plants its heading with a crescent-wide c and no variation in stroke thickness. Tsukimi Rounded sans is the softer partner, all parenthesis-round forms with parallel edges.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tuffy: Commanding and distinctive, Baumans swings a wrench-wide c across lines that never vary in thickness. And Tuffy sits underneath like a pencil sketch, pressing no harder anywhere, with a widely parted s.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-urbanist: Urbanist writes like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut, its strokes trailing as single-width as a rolling-ball line. Under Baumans, paragraphs of it would flow smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-varela: Baumans heads the pair with a crescent-wrench c and strokes that never swell or thin. Then Varela, a modern sans, gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching width and its c a wide mouth.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-varela-round: A c shaped like a crescent wrench opened wide gives Baumans its look, with every stroke held to a single thickness. Varela Round stays gentler beside it, its wide-mouthed rounds and framed counters easing the heading's firmness.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-varta: Plain, unshaded lines and a wrench-wide c: that's Baumans. Varta brings big open eyes to every e and a, so the heading's plain lines get an open-faced partner beneath.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-vazirmatn: Baumans has no calligraphic thinning anywhere, just a crescent-wrench c and lines of unvarying thickness. But Vazirmatn, an approachable sans-serif, never lets its s tighten, holding it generously open.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Baumans carries a rounded-nib look, its wrench-wide c and unswelling stroke ends giving a heading real presence. Wix Madefor Text, a sans with open terminals, takes over from there.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ysabeau: Distinctive, Baumans never mixes bold and light strokes in a word. Ysabeau sweeps in below with curves that never close up, a sans whose approachable manner softens the heading's command.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ysabeau-infant: Baumans, with rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, is best at making a heading look commanding. Ysabeau Infant does the quieter job, its outward-pointing terminals like tongs giving text a friendly face.
